[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/01 (Mon) 23:14  
[USER] User inquired about integration testing in game development.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Game developers perform integration testing by identifying components, setting up a testing environment, writing integration tests, running tests, fixing issues, and repeating the process until all components work correctly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Integration testing can add overhead to the game development process but is essential for ensuring components work well together.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Automated testing tools can help speed up the integration testing process and reduce the impact on development time.  
[USER] User asked how often game developers perform integration testing and if it slows down the development process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Game developers usually perform integration testing regularly throughout the development process, with frequency varying by project scope and complexity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Skipping integration testing can lead to significant issues, and many developers use automated tools to assist with the process.  
[USER] User requested an example of a specific game that underwent rigorous integration testing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" is an example of a game that underwent extensive integration testing by CD Projekt Red.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The testing process involved multiple stages, including automated and manual testing to ensure gameplay mechanics and graphical elements worked seamlessly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The rigorous integration testing helped identify and address issues early, contributing to the game's critical acclaim and quality.  
[USER] User expressed curiosity about whether integration testing is standard in the industry or if some companies skip it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Integration testing is a standard practice in the gaming industry, but some smaller studios may skip it due to resource limitations or a desire for quicker releases.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Skipping integration testing can lead to negative player feedback and impact a studio's reputation.  
[USER] User asked if developers use specific tools for integration testing or if it is mostly manual.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Game developers use both manual testing and automated testing tools for integration testing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Manual testing is time-consuming but necessary for catching issues that automated tools may miss.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Automated testing tools like Unity Test Runner and Jenkins are used to automate the testing process and manage version control.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Unity Test Runner is an automated testing tool that helps developers run tests, while Jenkins is a continuous integration tool that automates testing and building processes.  
[USER] User expressed interest in the various software tools available to developers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Game developers use a range of software tools for different stages of development
